review_description: Not the cheapest, but accurate and reliable advice including a site visit before quoting. Installed by a professional team that knows what they are doing. They take a lot of care to get the job right. They also gave lots of assistance in getting the system grid connected, and with setting up the remote monitoring software. A good bundle of documentation (including COCs and Maintenance Logs) provide at completion.

Fairly quick to turn a quote around. Not a nearmap quoter, actually visits the site, and was able to inform me of extra electrical upgrades required to my supply and SAPN requirements for meterbox location. You can  probably get cheaper quotes elsewhere, but the components are first rate. Tidy, good install.
